name: Trigonometric Ratios
roadmap: Start with the fundamental SOH CAH TOA ratios in right-angled triangles. Master the exact values of special angles (30°, 45°, 60°) which are essential for non-calculator papers. Finally, learn the core identities to simplify complex trigonometric expressions.
roadmap_zh: 從直角三角形的基本 SOH CAH TOA 比例開始。掌握特殊角（30°、45°、60°）的精確值，這對於非計算機試卷至關重要。最後，學習核心恆等式以簡化複雜的三角表達式。

concepts.name: The Fundamental Ratios (SOH CAH TOA)
concepts.key_takeaway: SOH CAH TOA is your primary tool for solving right-angled triangles. 'Opposite' and 'Adjacent' are defined relative to the angle \theta.
concepts.key_takeaway_zh: SOH CAH TOA 是求解直角三角形的主要工具。「對邊」(Opposite) 和「鄰邊」(Adjacent) 是相對於角度 \theta 定義的。

concepts.name: Special Angles (30^\circ, 45^\circ, 60^\circ)
concepts.key_takeaway: Derive exact values using the unit isosceles triangle (45-45-90) and the equilateral half (30-60-90). Essential for Level 5+ precision.
concepts.key_takeaway_zh: 使用等腰直角三角形 (45-45-90) 和等邊三角形的一半 (30-60-90) 來推導精確值。這對於達到 5 級或以上水平的精確度至關重要。

concepts.name: Core Trigonometric Identities
concepts.key_takeaway: The Pythagorean identity stems from the unit circle (x^2 + y^2 = r^2). Use these to simplify expressions and solve trigonometric equations.
concepts.key_takeaway_zh: 畢氏恆等式源於單位圓 (x^2 + y^2 = r^2)。使用這些恆等式來簡化表達式並求解三角方程。
